metadata.name: Avocado vault
metadata.description: Avocado NFT Vault is a secure, yield-optimized digital vault designed to protect and grow your NFT assets. Built with decentralized infrastructure, the vault allows collectors and investors to safely store NFTs while unlocking additional utility — from fractionalization and liquidity pooling to staking and curated lending.
